source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Heater and Air Conditioning, p.1A-3

procedures.title: Blower motor: remove and install
steps: If the car has a radiator supply tank, take out its screws and set the tank aside.
Remove the screws holding the motor to the blower case and lift out the motor; pry gently on the flange if the sealer is holding it.
Remove the nut retaining the blower wheel and separate the wheel from the motor.
notes: Fit the blower wheel onto the motor with its open end facing away from the motor.
See figure 4 in the manual (blower and case).
